articles.summary: CHICAGO, IL, 7 APR 2026 --- Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG), one of the 10 largest global financial groups, in partnership with the Art Institute of Chicago, presented Beyond Tradition—Emerging Japanese Craft Artists, a cultural program highlighting the evolution of traditional Japanese craftsmanship through contemporary artistic expression.
articles.title: MUFG Kogei Project and the Art Institute of Chicago Host “Beyond Tradition—Emerging Japanese Craft Artists”
